title: Acceleration a1 magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a1 = 1 m/s² from the given initial motion data (v=20 m/s at t=20 s).

title: Speed at slope bottom
description: Important: Correctly finds the speed v2 at t=50 s using v2 = a1 * t2, yielding 50 m/s.

title: Acceleration a2 magnitude

title: Speed after 6 seconds
description: Essential: Correctly computes the speed 6 s after reaching the bottom using v = v2 + a2*t, yielding 38 m/s.

title: Horizontal distance traveled
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance on the horizontal plane using kinematic equations, yielding 625 m.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Important: Maintains consistent sign convention for acceleration and velocity in both motion stages.

title: Unit analysis

title: Incorrect acceleration sign

title: Misinterpreting time intervals
